notes: Public benchmark priors for NanoGPT subscription models. Priors order candidates only until measured evidence (orchestrate foreman eval, capability observations) exists. Vendor-reported and secondary figures are flagged; benchmark versions differ across sources and are not comparable across columns. Abliteration evidence: no controlled abliterated-vs-base comparison was found for these variants; a 2025 comparison of abliteration tools found GSM8K changes from +1.5 to -18.8 points depending on tool and model, with Qwen-family models degrading more than others.
